specialization.description: Abilities deal more damage the more of your Physical-vs-Arcane attribute levels sit in their school. An even split gives x1 to both; all-in on one school gives x(1 + maxBonus) to it.

spellMastery.description: Spells deal baseMultiplier x (1 + Arcana x perArcana) on top of Arcana's normal +8%: weak early, large late. Arcane's zero-to-hero curve.
